'''Solara''' is a parliamentary democracy and major southern power on [[Alberion]]. Its capital is [[Congrave]], a coastal political center that became important both during the [[Avant Great War]] and the [[Solara-Khalindar War]].

== Formation ==

Solara was formed in early 1538 after the [[Solaran War of Unification]], a seven-year conflict among predecessor states in the Solaran homeland. Old source material identifies the [[Grand Duchy of Solan]], the [[Kingdom of Congrave]], and the [[Kingdom of Albion]] as central to that process.

The Grand Duchy of Solan and the Kingdom of Congrave defeated Albion and founded the new Solaran state. The coalition selected [[John "Lee" Greener]] as the first [[President of Solara]] because of his actions during the war. The exact dynastic, territorial, and constitutional settlement still needs a fuller early Solaran history pass.

The resulting state developed a parliamentary democratic system with a large representative legislature, strong civilian political institutions, and a national identity built around unity against external threats.

== Language And Education ==

The main vernacular language of the country is the [[Solaran Language]]. Older ceremonial and liturgical language traditions are associated with [[Solra]], the Elder Tongue.

In 1895, the [[Solaran Parliament]] commissioned the [[Solaran Alphabet|Sunline]] alphabet through the [[Education Reform Act of 1895]]. The alphabet was adopted in 1898 after school testing and became the practical writing system for mass literacy, public education, newspapers, business, and government notices.

This language system let Solara preserve elite ceremonial continuity while building a modern literate public sphere. By the twentieth century, Sunline literacy and [[Solaran Education]] were part of the administrative capacity behind Solara's national unity.

Solara also had a source-attested literary culture. [[Jane Pensworth]] began writing the [[A Wild World]] series in 1897, and the first book was published in 1901, making her one of the clearest named figures in [[Solaran Literature]].

== Great War Diplomacy ==

During the [[Avant Great War]], Solara was a major member of the anti-Vesperan coalition. In 1940, Solaran leaders hosted the [[Solaran-Khalindarian Conference of 1940]] at Congrave to secure Khalindar's support against the [[Vesperan Empire]].

The wartime promises made at that conference became one of Solara's most consequential diplomatic liabilities. Khalindar later argued that Solara had used Khalindarian manpower and geography against Vespera, then refused to deliver the full postwar settlement.

== Prewar Confidence ==

By the late 1980s, Solara was wealthy, technologically advanced, and nationally united. Its leaders and public treated large carrier groups, air power, and national resolve as credible deterrents against Khalindar.

That confidence became a weakness. The opening attack on [[Albroke]] exposed gaps in harbor security and showed that a less advanced enemy could still use surprise, sabotage, mines, submarines, and one-way strike tactics to inflict severe damage.

== Solara-Khalindar War ==

Solara entered the [[Solara-Khalindar War]] after Khalindar attacked Albroke in March 1990. The war tested Solara's military system more severely than any conflict since the Avant Great War.

The loss and later recapture of [[Congrave]], the defense of [[Reasalbor]], the [[Battle of Solara]] air campaign, and the long naval attrition phase all became central to Solaran memory. Solara's unity did not collapse during the war; instead, national pride and anger at the Albroke attack helped sustain mobilization.

== Postwar Institution Building ==

In November 1994, Solara and the [[Union of Zhensanov]] formed the [[Avant Garde Global Peace Initiative]] as a deterrence and mediation framework during the final stage of the war. Later charter work continued after the January 1995 ceasefire, but the political origin belongs to late 1994.
